top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure services provided by the nursing facility meet professional standards of quality.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Keep aisles, corridors, and exits free of obstruction in case of emergency.
Have properly located and lighted "Exit" signs.
Provide exit doors that are held open by devices that will automatically close on the activation of a fire alarm or smoke detector.
Have stairways and smokeproof enclosures used as exits that meet safety requirements.
Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.
Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.
Have properly installed electrical wiring and gas equipment.
Follow proper procedures when the fire alarm was out of service for more than 4 hours.
Have simulated fire drills held at unexpected times.
